title: Atɛntrenee Wɔ Aguadifo Mu
intro: Ná onipa bi gyina nnipa bi a mfaso ho nnaadaa no anim, na ɔfrɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnyɛ nokwaredi ne atɛntrenee wɔ wɔn nkitahodi mu. Allah akoa yi bɔɔ kɔkɔ sɛ ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔde susudua tiawa mma na wɔmfa nsenia no nsɛe. Nkurɔfo no ampene so sɛ wobetie, na wohunahuna wɔn sɛ wɔbɛpam saa onipa yi afi wɔn asase so. Ná asase no ankasa bɛsɔre atemmu atia wɔn. Hena ne saa onipa yi a ogyinaa hɔ maa atɛntrenee wɔ aguadifo no mu?
clues: Wɔsomaa me sɛ ɔbɔfo kɔɔ nkurɔfo bi a wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ aguadi ne aguadi mu kɛse nkyɛn.
Me nkurɔfo de susudua tiawa ma bere a wɔkari nneɛma ma afoforo no.
Wohunahunaa me sɛ sɛ mekɔ so frɛ wɔn ba gyidi mu a, wɔbɛpam me afi asase no so.
Wɔkae me sɛ ɔkasafo a ɔkasa yiye sen biara wɔ adiyifo no mu.
Asasewosow a ano yɛ den gyee me nkurɔfo a ɛmaa wonnyaa nkwa wɔ wɔn afie mu.
Wɔsomaa me kɔɔ Madyanfoɔ a wɔwɔ Hijaz atifi fam no nkyɛn.

trial.label: Sɔhwɛ/Asɛm a esii
options: Wohunahunaa no sɛ wɔbɛpam no afi asase no so
Me nkurɔfo tow gu ogya a ɛredɛw mu
Ɔne farao a ɔyɛ ɔhoɔdenfo bi nkonyaayifo hyiae
Ohyiaa ahwehwɛde a ɛne sɛ wobenya yoma a ɔyɛ ɔbea afi ɔbotan mu
Mihuu sɛnea abɔfo dɔm bi sɛee me kurow no
trial.answer: Wohunahunaa no sɛ wɔbɛpam no afi asase no so

outcome.label: Nsunsuansoɔ
options: Asasewosow a ano yɛ den gyee me nkurɔfo
Nsuyiri kɛse bi memee me nkurɔfo
Mframa a ɛteɛteɛm bɔɔ me nkurɔfo hwetee
Wogyee me bere a na mewɔ apataa kɛse bi yafunu mu no
outcome.answer: Asasewosow a ano yɛ den gyee me nkurɔfo

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰشُعَيْبُ أَصَلَوٰتُكَ تَأْمُرُكَ أَن نَّتْرُكَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَآ أَوْ أَن نَّفْعَلَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِنَا مَا نَشَـٰٓؤُا۟ ۖ إِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ ٱلْحَلِيمُ ٱلرَّشِيدُ
verse: They said, "O Shuʿayb, does your prayer [i.e., religion] command you that we should leave what our fathers worship or not do with our wealth what we please? Indeed, you are the forbearing, the discerning!" (11:87)
